events.strEvent: UFC Fight Night 292 Moicano vs Nolan
events.strFilename: UFC 2026-10-31 UFC Fight Night 292 Moicano vs Nolan
events.strDescriptionEN: Renato Moicano faces rising contender Tom Nolan in a five-round lightweight main event at the Meta APEX. Moicano looks to defend his place among the division’s leading contenders, while Nolan enters his first UFC main event on a five-fight winning streak. Randy Brown vs Jacobe Smith provides the co-main event in a card with important ranking implications.
